prompts.prompt: Wide-angle photograph of a children's forest mystery performance at Teaterverket Svea in Stockholm. Young audience members and adult chaperones sit on tiered wooden benches bathed in warm afternoon light from tall industrial windows, watching a dimly lit stage where shadowy figures move among pine branches.

Medium shot inside Dieselverkstaden during a parent-and-tot singing circle. A mixed group of toddlers perched on laps and standing adults form a loose semicircle on the worn wooden floor, soft natural light from clerestory windows illuminating smiling faces and open mouths mid-song.

Environmental photo of Kulturhuset Stadsteatern's glass-walled foyer before a family puppet show. Children press small hands against the panoramic windows overlooking Sergels torg, golden late-afternoon sun casting long geometric shadows across the polished stone floor and colorful backpacks scattered nearby.

Close-up detail shot of a child's small hand clutching a crumpled paper ticket stub, with the blurred background showing Teaterverket Svea's painted brick wall and a glowing amber stage light reflecting off the child's navy winter jacket sleeve.

Intimate close-up portrait of a kindergarten-aged child gazing upward at a hand-puppet swan performer on a small Kulturhuset Stadsteatern studio stage, warm tungsten footlights catching the wonder in wide brown eyes and illuminating tousled hair in a soft halo.
